benchmark_method: Five sequential runs per binary per workload, alternating order; normal clocks; posix_spawn and per-child wait4; warm filesystem caches, no explicit warmup; raw outputs compared on every pair.
phase: Seventh pass: row-sized chi-square expectations, window-pi range updates, packed masks and rolling counts
baseline_scope: Complete CLI regression against original commit with matching configurations; performance and actual-function probes against frozen sixth-pass delivery. No Perl source changes.

normal.clock: fixed_time.c linked in both executables; no output normalization

lapack.clock: fixed_time.c linked in both executables; no output normalization

chisq_probe.comparison: memcmp of chisq, dof and pval doubles; integer sample counts, final floating exception flags and errno also equal.
limits: Extracted real functions, not complete CLI output.
Existing signed dimension/count overflow and mismatched input-vector lengths excluded.
Valid positive dimensions; empty observations and invalid allele IDs retaining legacy index-zero behavior included.
No claim for signaling/trapping floating environments, excess-precision architectures not run here or different math libraries.

window_pi_probe.scope: Actual candidate helpers; previous-source range loop with identifiers adapted; direct mask scans and exact legacy char narrowing as oracle. Each configuration is counted separately.
limitations: No full CLI or mask-file parser test; complete CLI corpus covers those separately.
Bin probes preserve unsigned-long modular arithmetic; existing signed-overflow dimensions and invalid indices are excluded.
Endpoint wrapping is tested without allocating a multi-GiB mask.

scratch_comparison.method: Complete raw-byte multisets; random private filenames ignored only. Public output files and diagnostics remain byte-exact.

limitations: Finite same-platform tests, not a universal guarantee for every input, compiler, architecture, math library or failure mode. Existing undefined behavior is not repaired.
CLI regressions use fixed clocks for diagnostics/RNG and compare raw bytes without tolerance, normalization or sorting. Normal-clock benchmarks retain elapsed-time diagnostic differences separately.

Chi-square expected rows remain stored as doubles before use; observed counts, marginal sums, pow, accumulation order and gamma are unchanged. All expected calculations remain, but expectation and chi-square instructions now interleave by row.

Actual chi-square probes use FE_TONEAREST and nontrapping arithmetic and compare final errno and floating exception flags. Floating traps, instruction-level failure timing and excess-precision architectures not run here are outside the evidence.

Window-pi difference cells use unsigned-long modular arithmetic, original coordinate expressions, resize behavior and four counter types. Read-only output prefixes preserve duplicate chromosome output; bin storage remains O(B), not reduced by this change.

Packed masks store exact original char-to-short-to-char threshold/invert decisions. Mask-file reading, filtering, retained strings and chromosome scans remain; a roughly eightfold mask payload reduction does not imply eightfold process RSS reduction.
Rolling counts reuse monotone overlapping emitted ranges only. Empty/decreasing/disjoint ranges reset; synthetic unsigned endpoint wraps are checked without allocating multi-GiB masks.

Original signed coordinate/count/dimension overflow, invalid vector indices, chromosome/mask parser undefined behavior and resource-exhaustion timing remain outside a universal byte-equivalence claim.
No extra prefix array, site cache, floating reassociation, threshold change, window change or alternative statistical method was introduced.
Perl source is unchanged; previous nondeterminism and missing-tabix limitations remain, with no prior pass counts added to current totals.
